Type: rattan tub armchair
Use: relaxing, extra seating, casual dining; living room, sunroom, bedroom, dining room
Style: bohemian, coastal, rustic
Materials: hand-woven natural rattan, bamboo legs
Colors: warm honey rattan, light natural tan
Shape: rounded tub back curving into the arms, arched openings between back and arms, woven diamond pattern detail, woven seat, four slim splayed bamboo legs, compact and light
Feel: warm, relaxed, natural, airy
Goes with: plants, linen cushions, light wood, white walls; bohemian, coastal or tropical living rooms and sunrooms
